lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters; larger, more isolated centroids in the mid-body transitioning to smaller, more densely packed clusters posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, forming a recognizable grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, displaying a distinct vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the first dorsal fin, with distinct spots visible near the center and posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A green artificial tracking tag is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (commensal fish) are attached to the ventral-lateral area of the flank.
